name: Adrenaline
effect: While you are down to your last Health chunk, you get a bonus action each exchange.

name: Conduit
effect: When you pick up a Clue, Rift or Bounty token, clear 1 marked Health box or 1 Dread box.

name: Greyhound
effect: Ignore one terrain aspect when you move into a zone.

name: Packmule
effect: When you find a tool or a consumable, take one more.

name: Hornskin
effect: +2 to defend against blunt melee weapons.

name: Determination
effect: When you sprint (give up your action to move twice), you keep your cover bonus to defence.

name: Iron Repeater
effect: Chained shot with lever-action rifles and shotguns: after an aimed shot, make one extra shot that exchange without losing the aim bonus.

name: Resilience
effect: When you are revived, also clear your Mild consequence.

name: Bolt Thrower
effect: Your crossbow is reloaded for free at the end of each exchange.

name: Levering
effect: Lever-action weapons: up to 3 extra shots.

name: Salveskin
effect: Once per mission, ignore one fire hit: no boxes burned.

name: Fanning
effect: Single-action revolvers: up to 3 extra shots.

name: Ghoul
effect: When you kill a Grunt in your zone, clear 1 marked (not burned) Health box.

name: Gator Legs
effect: Ignore water and mud terrain aspects, and moving crouched through water makes no noise.

name: Deadeye Scopesmith
effect: Chained shot with short-scope (Deadeye) weapons: after an aimed shot, make one extra shot that exchange without losing the aim bonus.

name: Silent Killer
effect: Your melee attacks are silent: nobody gets a Notice roll to hear them.

name: Lightfoot
effect: Climbing, vaulting, jumping and falling make no noise.

name: Serpent
effect: In Dark Sight, interact with a Clue, Rift, banishable target or abandoned Bounty from an adjacent zone.

name: Physician
effect: Once per exchange, using a first aid kit is a free action.

name: Steady Aim
effect: +2 to aimed shots with scoped rifles.

name: Whispersmith
effect: Swapping weapons or tools is silent: it never gives away your position, and doesn't break Stealth.

name: Steady Hand
effect: +2 to aimed shots with scoped pistols and stockless weapons.

name: Marksman Scopesmith
effect: Chained shot with medium-scope (Marksman) weapons: after an aimed shot, make one extra shot that exchange without losing the aim bonus.

name: Bloodless
effect: Bleeding never escalates to Heavy Bleeding.

name: Frontiersman
effect: Each tool you carry can be used one extra time per mission.

name: Beastface
effect: Animals in your zone (crows, dogs, horses, ducks) don't react to you this exchange.

name: Decoy Supply
effect: Ammo crates restock your decoys.

name: Ambidextrous
effect: With a matched pair of pistols: up to 2 extra shots per pistol, and reloading both takes one action.

name: Tomahawk
effect: You can throw any melee weapon you find (axe, shovel, machete) with Throw.

name: Iron Sharpshooter
effect: Chained shot with bolt-action rifles: after an aimed shot, make one extra shot that exchange without losing the aim bonus.

name: Bolt Seer
effect: You recover your bolts and throwing knives after each fight.

name: Quartermaster
effect: You can carry a Medium weapon in addition to a Large one.

name: Mithridatist
effect: Poisoned ends at the end of the exchange instead of the end of the scene.

name: Pitcher
effect: You can throw explosives two zones away (Great +4).

name: Bulletgrubber
effect: After each skirmish, roll Resources vs Mediocre (+0): recover spent rounds equal to your shifts (max 3) for one weapon.

name: Poacher
effect: Placing and disarming traps is silent.

name: Dauntless
effect: As an action, defuse an explosive thrown into your zone before it goes off.

name: Kiteskin
effect: Falling damage is halved.

name: Iron Devastator
effect: Chained shot with pump-action shotguns: after an aimed shot, make one extra shot that exchange without losing the aim bonus.

name: Necromancer
effect: In Dark Sight, revive a downed partner up to two zones away, at the cost of 2 of your own Health boxes.

name: Vulture
effect: When you search a dead hunter, take one extra item, and you can take one of their traits even if they were already looted.

name: Doctor
effect: First aid kits clear twice as many Health boxes.

name: Sniper Scopesmith
effect: Chained shot with long-scope (Sniper) weapons: after an aimed shot, make one extra shot that exchange without losing the aim bonus.

name: Vigilant
effect: In Dark Sight, traps within two zones are revealed: no Notice roll needed to spot them.

name: Bulwark
effect: +2 to defend against explosions and harpoon attacks.
